_doc: CLOSED-LOOP-1 write-back: every lesson and decision as a row with a closing probe (file:<path> or grep:<path>::<regex>) that `python3 -m foundation orphans --check` executes on every PR and loop pass. Written by `python3 -m foundation writeback record --kind lesson|decision --probe SPEC`.

rows.title: CLOSED-LOOP-1: no artifact without a consuming loop, no wait on a person
rows.body: Rowan 2026-11-12: assume nothing is read, reviewed or decided by a person. Policy values in doctrine/closed-loop.json and closed_loop in autonomy/policy.json; foundation/orphans.py fails CI on a new orphan artifact, a non-identity-bound wait or a failing ledger probe; lessons and decisions are ledger rows with probes, not pages.

rows.title: Write-back is an executable ledger row, not a page
rows.body: writeback record --kind lesson|decision writes doctrine/decision-ledger.json with a required file or grep probe; closedloop --check runs every probe.

rows.title: Orphan scan delegates to the document audit
rows.body: CLOSED-LOOP-1 (orphans.py) and DOC-CONSUMED-1 (docs_audit.py) measured the same thing two ways. The document audit is the single definition; orphans.py keeps the human-wait check, the decision ledger and the backlog issue, and reads orphan documents from docs_audit.

rows.title: Fleet skips archived repositories
rows.body: ultrastable/seed is archived and read-only; its live copy is the seed directory of this repository. The fleet lane lists live repositories only and records an archived one instead of failing or opening a card.

rows.title: Deploy was green while live served old code
rows.body: Merged site 0.3.1 never went live: worker.js imports ../seed/analytics/analytics.js, the single-file upload returned code 10021, deploy-site.mjs ignored success=false, and the verify step fetched only an image. Measured after the fix: curl https://ultrastable.io/health returned version 0.3.1 and /org returned 200 (before: 0.2.0 and 404). deploy-site now runs on push to main for site paths; deploy exits nonzero unless the live version equals the repo VERSION; lane no longer fails on the concurrent-merge race.

rows.title: Bootstrap settings script reported success while doing nothing
rows.body: apply_github_settings.sh printed failures: 0 with jq missing, so every step was a no-op; it also failed on CRLF jq output, targeted six archived repos, omitted workers/spec/license, and treated GitHub plan limits as permanent red. Measured after the fix: running it from an org-admin gh session returned 'failures: 0 gated: 8' and the org description matches the config. It now requires jq and gh, strips CR, skips archived repos and reports plan-gated features as GATED. Lane merges via GITHUB_TOKEN never fire push workflows, so the lane dispatches deploy-site after merging deployable paths, and scripts/drift_probe.sh compares live version and org description daily; measured: site live=0.3.1 repo=0.3.1.

rows.title: Code repo holds code; administration lives in ops; the front door is one prompt bar
rows.body: Measured: 27 of 44 open issues in ultrastable/ultrastable were administration (funding, patent, legal, owner cards, org setup) and were transferred to the private ultrastable/ops repo; 19 code tasks remain and are executor-owned. Site 0.4.0 adds /start, a single prompt bar that stores a plain-words idea in KV; node site/site.test.mjs passes with the page and the POST. Next, tracked in ops: executor reads its queue from repo data so Issues can be disabled on the code repo, the idea consumer asks follow-up questions and scaffolds a Cloudflare Worker, and the six archived duplicate repos are removed after a mirror backup.
